blocks.html: On ground signs and wall signs permitted to be constructed of combustible materials, if the display surface does not exceed 300 square feet (27.9 m 2 ), 50 percent of the display surface shall be permitted to be covered by approved plastic. If the area of a display surface exceeds 300 square feet (27.9 m 2 ), the area occupied or covered by approved plastics shall be limited to 150 square feet (13.9 m 2 ) plus 25 percent of the difference between 150 square feet (13.9 m 2 ) and the total area of display surface. The area of plastic on a display surface shall not in any case exceed 575 square feet (53.4 m 2 ), unless approved by the commissioner.
